Property partners ('mitra') are not employees and are not counted: these are the 100+ landowners and building managers named in the January 2025 announcement, some of whom co-invest in racks on revenue share.
rows.funding_note: The figure is a US$5.5M floor taken from a share issue, not from a round announcement. DealStreetAsia's Data Vantage column of 9 Jan 2025 (Abhishek Chatterjee) reports that Soul Parking's Singapore parent, Soul Parking Technologies Pte. Ltd., 'last issued new shares in September with a total value of $5.5 million'. The story is for subscribers; the figure is in its published summary, and the free excerpt adds that AC Ventures is the largest shareholder with a 29.9% stake. The article ran three days after the Series A extension was announced, and the September 2024 issue is most likely that round's close. DealStreetAsia's visible text does not say so, though, and the issue may include converted notes. Announced rounds, all undisclosed: (1) Seed, June 2020, co-led by AC Ventures and Agaeti Ventures with angel investors (DealStreetAsia 9 Jun 2020; DailySocial 10 Jun 2020: amount not stated). (2) Convertible notes into the Singapore holdco, led by Wavemaker Pacific 4 (Allen & Gledhill deal note, 13 Mar 2023; IDNFinancials dates Wavemaker's entry to 2022). (3) Series A extension ('Series A+'), announced 6 Jan 2025, co-led by AC Ventures (now ACV Capital) and AppWorks, with Taiwan Mobile, USPACE and Wavemaker Ventures (ACV, Wavemaker and AppWorks releases; Business News Asia and IDNFinancials report the amount as undisclosed). No announcement of the original Series A was found. Genesis Alternative Ventures, a Singapore venture-debt fund, lists Soul Parking as a portfolio company and the CEO calls it an existing backer (Mar 2023); no terms are published. Tracker context only, not the published figure: PitchBook shows a US$7.75M Series A1 (Jan 2025) and US$13M in total; Preqin shows US$3.75M for the January 2025 round; Dealroom shows a US$1.5M seed (Jan 2021); nstartup shows a US$1.45M seed (June 2020). DealStreetAsia's 2020 seed story said only that 'sources peg the deal size to be in the early-million range'.
investors: Genesis Alternative Ventures (venture debt fund; terms not published)
rows.valuation_note: No publicly reported valuation. Preqin shows a US$18.75M valuation at the January 2025 round; that is tracker-only and not used.
rows.verify_note: Test 1 (venture-built): a founder-built startup on venture money since a June 2020 seed co-led by AC Ventures and Agaeti Ventures. Wavemaker-led convertible notes followed in 2022-23, then a Series A extension announced in January 2025, co-led by AC Ventures (now ACV Capital) and AppWorks with Taiwan Mobile, USPACE and Wavemaker Ventures. AC Ventures is the largest shareholder at 29.9% (DealStreetAsia, Jan 2025). It is not an incumbent's product line. Agency rule: it is not an agency or reseller. It builds its own patented Compact Motorcycle Storage racks (DJKI patent, per its site) and its own parking operating system and app. Test 2 (own entity): PT Solusi Parkir Nusantara is the App Store and Google Play developer of the Soul Parking app (App Store: 'Copyright © PT Solusi Parkir Nusantara'). The PT signed a May 2024 MoU with PT Integrasi Transit Jakarta through its Direktur Utama, Andru Surya Wijaya, and bid in 2026 parking tenders in Banyumas and Purbalingga. It is held by the Singapore holdco Soul Parking Technologies Pte. Ltd. (Allen & Gledhill, Mar 2023); operations and the head office are in Indonesia. Test 3 (headcount): the LinkedIn live count is 96, read 2026-10-05. HQ: Harvia Suites, Jl. Perjuangan 63-64, Kebon Jeruk, Jakarta Barat, per the site footer and the Google Play developer address. The footer prints postal code 11620, but the building is in Kelurahan Kebon Jeruk, code 11530, as Google Play, Pintarnya and hotel listings give it. Liveness: soulparking.co.id answers 200 on 2026-10-05. The app was updated in July 2026 (Google Play 20 Jul 2026; App Store v2.15.2, 24 Jul). ACV Capital's post of 14 Sep 2026 says it manages 150 locations. Hiring posts date from May, Sep and Oct 2026, and it won the GOR Satria Purwokerto parking contract in Feb 2026. Doubtful points: (a) Founding year. The company's LinkedIn page and co-founder interviews give 2019 (KrAsia Jan 2022: founded in 2019; CompassList Nov 2020: launched in late 2019). Forbes, Katadata and Uzone give 2020; the first racks opened in Feb 2020 and the seed closed in June 2020. Tracxn and IDNFinancials give 2015, which matches the founders' earlier parking work. The record uses 2019. (b) The site's homepage counters still read '70+ locations', below the 150 that ACV and Forbes report. (c) The founding team changed. The 2020 seed release names Kemas Ilham Akbar as CEO among five co-founders. KrAsia names Andru Surya Wijaya Jo, Bahagia Waluyo, Kemas Ilham Akbar and Kemas Riza Aulya. Kenneth Darmansjah joined as CFO in 2020 and became CEO in 2022 (AppWorks). (d) Forbes' 150-location and tier-2/3 expansion lines are confirmed by ACV Capital's 14 Sep 2026 post. Namesakes: soulparking.com is an unrelated poetry blog. soulparking.online is a Lovable-built demo with made-up Kuala Lumpur data and an unknown owner. Neither is this company, and no other Indonesian 'Soul Parking' was found.
